who: Joan B. Landes, Penn State historian of eighteenth-century France and gender, PhD New York University 1975.

evidence.says: Penn State identifies Joan B. Landes as its professor of early modern history and women's studies, with a 1975 NYU PhD; her books include Women and the Public Sphere in the Age of the French Revolution.
The 2010–11 graduate bulletin lists Joan Landes, PhD NYU, as Ferree Professor of Early Modern History and Women's Studies.
LC establishes Joan B. Landes through her 1988 Women and the Public Sphere in the Age of the French Revolution, also listed on the Penn State page.
The other candidate is John D. Landes at Westinghouse R&D, associated with Elastic-plastic fracture.

notes: NYU doctorate, Penn State affiliation in the relevant period, and matching book establish the Joan B. Landes authority; John D. Landes is a different person.
